# Ganesh Datta

> Ganesh Datta installs sales infrastructure for coaches and founders so booking, follow-up, CRM, and content systems keep running without constant manual effort.

Primary site: https://ganeshdatta.me/

## Core pages
- [Home](https://ganeshdatta.me/): Sales throughput systems — booking, follow-up, CRM, content tied to pipeline
- [About](https://ganeshdatta.me/about.html): Who Ganesh R Datta is and how the operating work is scoped
- [Book a session](https://cal.com/ganesh-datta-bygktk/sales-throughput-session): 30-minute working session on the actual bottleneck

## What gets installed
- Call-booking infrastructure that removes manual scheduling
- Follow-up and no-show recovery that does not depend on memory
- CRM ownership that is visible instead of implied
- Content distribution tied to conversations, not random posting

## Fit
For operators already selling through calls. Not for beginners, first-time sellers, or people looking for a course.
